scope: Fresh verification of the editor fixes plus missing photos across home, collection and reader navigation
test_changes: Added test/review/album_photo_navigation_verification_test.dart with in-memory image downloads, real decoding and an isolated reader rotation case
Updated the existing edit-button surface assertion in test/widget/home_book_depth_test.dart from AnimatedContainer to the current Material widget; its color/geometry expectations are preserved
editor_verified: A reorder immediately after undo preserves the newest photo geometry and commits only order
Stale reorder callbacks cannot overwrite additions, deletions, another order change or a replacement edit session
Actual pointer drops finishing after undo retain the undone geometry
Rapid More taps during dismissal do not overlap tool sheets or drop the selected action
The More gate survives parent rebuilds and stale callbacks and is released after cancellation
A fast reverse scroll of 72 unresolved thumbnails starts only two native calls and requests the top photo once
Fast close/reopen shares active thumbnail work; no-consumer queued work is discarded
Completed thumbnail entries obey the 32-entry/2-MiB bounds independently of pending requests
Late thumbnail results cannot replace a newly selected photo or refill a disposed panel cache
Eight repeated arrangement visits detach the tested scroll controllers and image listeners

findings.title: Native photo widgets reuse a rejected signed storage URL after route return
findings.cause: The native branch renders _resolvedUrls directly. The shared map has no expiry metadata; a download failure does not invalidate that URL or expose the bounded recovery used by _WebStorageImage. The storage resolver creates six-hour Supabase signed URLs.
findings.trigger: A previously shown photo is remounted after decoded pixels are evicted and the old URL is no longer accepted, for example after expiry or revocation.

proof.test: review: native route return must recover a rejected cached storage URL

findings.recommendation: Give native storage photos a bounded refresh/retry path and expiry-aware URL reuse. Invalidate only the failed URL version, coalesce refresh requests and stop late updates after source changes/disposal. Preserve existing decode bounds and custom placeholder/error rendering.

findings.title: A failed preview prevents a valid original from appearing in both home and reader
findings.cause: _photoSource selects the first nonempty previewUrl/imageUrl/originalUrl once. Painting and prepareImages use only that candidate. On download failure neither path tries the remaining valid source, so a stored preview can mask an accessible original indefinitely.

tests: review: home cover must use the valid original when its preview is unavailable
review: reader photo preparation must recover through the valid original

findings.recommendation: Use a shared, finite candidate-fallback policy for visible painting and reader preparation, deduplicating equal sources. Try an available imageUrl/originalUrl after a preview fails, with the existing screen-sized decode cap; do not switch every photo to unrestricted original decoding.

findings.title: Rotating during reader entry triggers a layout mutation exception
findings.cause: While the opening overlay is visible, the stage keeps AnimatedSize mounted with Duration.zero. A portrait-to-landscape size change restarts its animation during layout; in the installed Flutter runtime that synchronously marks the same RenderAnimatedSize dirty inside performLayout.

tests: rotation during opening lands on the new reader geometry
review: rotating the reader while its entry cover is visible must not mutate layout
proof.exception: A RenderAnimatedSize was mutated in its own performLayout implementation

findings.recommendation: Bypass the size-animation render object while entry/reduced motion requires an immediate geometry change. Keep the existing opening overlay and current reader target geometry; do not add a second animation or image capture.
findings.limits: This confirms a debug/widget-runtime layout exception. It does not establish identical release-mode rendering failure or prove it caused the user's specific missing photo.

home_reader_existing_suite_initial.failure_breakdown: One genuine entry-rotation layout exception; six outdated AnimatedContainer finder assertions for the current Material edit button

new_photo_navigation_cases.passing_case: Eight hidden/resume cycles plus cache pressure restore the home photo, with zero live/pending image entries after unmount

limits: Review only: the three newly confirmed production issues remain unfixed. The added regression tests intentionally fail on those issues. Downloads and URL rejection were simulated with in-memory fixtures, so the tests prove the code paths rather than identify the user's particular album or remote object. Resource-release and bounded-work tests passed for the editor; no claim is made that all device frame drops or native memory leaks have been ruled out.
